about: TotalSegmentator v3's record before rule version 2: the 142 subjects the older rule counted, from a subject list that sits on the grid alone. Since 2026-10-29 the member's rows are data/gold3-ct/totalsegmentator/facts.jsonl, one per subject of the public release, and the field test (tools/gold3_field.py, data/gold3-ct/admission.json) decides which are gold 3. This file keeps the older count and its list so the two can be set side by side once a grid job reads the list.
count_basis: v3 subjects whose release masks hold C2 to L5 and the sacrum with at least 200 voxels each and no metal (bordercall holdings/gold-tier-3.md; pull request #420's corpus-tiers draft); 14 more that the level or metal rule dropped wait for a read
waits_for: a grid job reads the list, checks its sha256 and sets its 142 beside the subjects the field test admits
